name: Artzio Artist Marketplace for WooCommerce
author: Urban-Age Solutions Private Limited

sections.description:
Create an artist marketplace where creators can sell artworks using WooCommerce. This plugin allows artists to register, upload their artworks, and manage their portfolio while integrating seamlessly with WooCommerce for sales and commission tracking.

Artzio Artist Marketplace for WooCommerce is a comprehensive solution designed to transform a standard WooCommerce store into a multi-vendor marketplace tailored for artists and creators. By integrating seamlessly with WooCommerce, it allows site administrators to onboard artists who can list, manage, and sell their unique artworks directly through the platform.

This plugin provides a dedicated environment for artists to showcase their portfolios and manage their products, while giving marketplace owners full control over the ecosystem via the WordPress dashboard. It is specifically built to support the unique needs of art sellers, ensuring a streamlined experience for both vendors and customers.

Key Features
– Artist / Creator Marketplace Support: Enables multiple artists to register and sell on a single platform.
– WooCommerce-Based Product Listing: Leverages the robust WooCommerce architecture for secure and reliable product management.
– Vendor-Specific Product Management: Allows artists to manage their own inventory and product details.
– Frontend Seller Experience: Provides a user-friendly frontend interface for artists to interact with the marketplace.
– Admin Control via WordPress Dashboard: Centralized management for administrators to oversee artists, products, and settings.
– Extensible and Developer-Friendly Architecture: Built with clean code practices to allow for future enhancements and customizations.

Compatibility
– WordPress: Latest stable version (Backward compatible)
– WooCommerce: Latest stable version
– The plugin adheres to strict WordPress coding standards to ensure reliability and performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under the ‘Artzio’ menu in the admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is an extension for WooCommerce.
